li.label: told the bees
li.description: I went round the hives and told the bees. It's an old thing to do, and it helped more than I thought.

plain.li: [dead] Bees, {NAME} has died, and I thought you should hear it from us.
[dead] I've come to tell you that {NAME} is gone.
[dead] {NAME} won't be coming by the hives any more, bees.
[dead] We've lost {NAME}, so keep quiet a while with us.
[new] Bees, this is about {NAME}, who has come to live with us.
[new] There's someone new, bees, and their name is {NAME}.
[new] {NAME} is one of us now, so don't sting them.
[new] I've come to tell you about {NAME}, who's just joined us.
